registered_process: BFullLaueBraggProcess derives from G4VDiscreteProcess and is added to the gamma G4ProcessManager as a non-forced finite-MFP post-step process competing with standard EM
online_physics_backend: Darwin-Hamilton mosaic formula or external rocking-curve CSV converted to an equivalent finite diffraction mean free path; Geant4 standard EM processes remain enabled
custom_laue_branch_scope: DIFFRACT is the only sampled custom Laue branch; ABSORB/TRANSMIT probabilities are backend diagnostics while standard Geant4 EM processes compete independently
transmitted_space_source: actual primary gamma focal-plane crossings recorded by BFullFocalPlaneSteppingAction
n_absorbed_field_scope: custom Laue branch only; not total Geant4 EM absorption
n_transmitted_field_scope: custom Laue branch only; use primary_or_transmitted_focal_crossings/transmitted_space.csv for tracked transmitted primaries
emergent_rta_definition: R: BFull-Laue-created gamma reaches focal plane; T: uncollided primary reaches focal plane with incident energy and direction; A_or_removed: all remaining primary events, including standard-EM absorption/scatter and diffracted photons lost before emergence
diffraction_validation_note: emergent EM-competing focal-plane diffracted fraction (laue_diffracted_focal_crossings/n_primaries) vs the absorption-included mosaic-Laue reference at the Bragg peak (Darwin-Hamilton closed form or external XOP/CRYSTAL curve); they should agree within Monte-Carlo and thick-crystal point-diffraction error, which is the gate that the EM-competing process reproduces the validated diffraction physics
